# Rules

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

biolint has 284 rules. Each one has a stable code, a default level, and a page with an example.

`--strict` raises the rules marked below to the level in the last column. `--explain CODE` prints a rule in the terminal.
